title: A non called script at runtime had this error: Script inherits from native type 'Resource', so it can't be assigned to an object of type: 'Node'
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.beta2.official [a013481b0]

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta2 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 9 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-11900K @ 3.50GHz (16 threads)

### Issue description

Using the same project from this issue: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/102319

I was changing out how I did a script I had an App_Settings resource, that I copied all the data from and moved to a Cigam_Settings resource. After doing that and adjusting the calls to now be for the Cigam_Settings I ran the app. But it gave the error of:
```rust
Script inherits from native type 'Resource', so it can't be assigned to an object of type: 'Node'
```

The problem is that particular resource was not being called from any other script or object. Later when I commented out the entire App_Settings file I was getting a RefCounted error, but do not have the exact phrase it said, because it was not recording then.

This video is just showing me seeing that nothing is calling it, and the resource node error:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ab254b57-5b7b-4ea2-9883-e8429e47a7c8

### Steps to reproduce

Not sure at this point

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Closing and reopening the project still had the issue. So I copied the project to make an MRP of it. At first it was still having the issue (even with the .godot folder deleted), but as I was removing files that were not needed for the MRP, it eventually fixed itself in that copy.

I then went back to my original project to see the error again, but magically it was fixed in that project as well.

At this point I cannot repeat the error.
So am not sure how helpful this bug report is...

What file or setting could have changed?
